newsitem.title: USA: Aircoa Hotel Partners says agrees to merger.
newsitem.headline: Aircoa Hotel Partners says agrees to merger.

text.p: Aircoa Hotel Partners LP said Monday it has agreed to merge with a subsidiary of the privately held Regal Hotel Management Inc.

The company said that under the merger, all class A units and class B units not currently held by Regal or its affiliates will be converted into the right to receive $3.10 per class A unit and $20.00 per class B unit in cash.
The company said the acquisition would be made through a merger of a subsidiary limited partnership owned by Regal into Aircoa.
The company said the deal is subject to the approval of unitholders owning a majority interest of the partnership's units at a special meeting.
The company said it expects the meeting will be held, and the merger will be consummated, during the third quarter of 1997.
The company said Regal and its affiliates own 71 percent of the class A units and 93.6 percent the class B units.
The company said Regal its affiliates have agreed to vote in favor of the merger.
